items.q: And Tizol, Juan Tizol's uncle,, who played bass with the Latin people.

ctx.x: ....that kind of bass. There was an old man, Harry Hall, who played bass. And Tizol, Juan Tizol's uncle,, who played bass with the Latin people. And there were two or three other Latin bass players from Cuba who played a three-string bass. But there was nobody played finger bass, you know what I mean; they played the bass with the bow in their hand...
